title: The smart speaker that laughed on its own
summary: In 2018 some Alexa speakers laughed without being asked. Amazon said Alexa could mistakenly hear the phrase Alexa, laugh, and changed the command.

beats.say: In two thousand eighteen, some Alexa speakers began laughing without being asked.
Owners reported laughter with no request and no blue light.
One owner thought a child was laughing behind them.
Amazon said Alexa can mistakenly hear the phrase Alexa, laugh.
The fix was to turn off the short command.
The new phrase was Alexa, can you laugh? A longer phrase is harder to mishear.
Alexa also changed its reply: it now confirms before laughing.
Amazon's first statement had not said what went wrong.
The cause was a misheard phrase, not a plan.
A short command was easy to trigger. A longer one was safer.
beats.cap: Misheard once. Fixed by a longer phrase.

facts.claim: Engadget reported on March 7, 2018 that Alexa owners said their speakers laughed without a request, and without the blue light that signals a response
facts.note: Engadget, March 7, 2018 (Jon Fingas): owners reported random laughter, sometimes ignoring requests; no blue light

facts.claim: One user described thinking a child was laughing behind them
facts.note: Engadget: a user was startled in the kitchen and thought a child was laughing behind them

facts.claim: Amazon said that in rare circumstances Alexa can mistakenly hear the phrase 'Alexa, laugh'
facts.note: NPR: Amazon statement 'In rare circumstances, Alexa can mistakenly hear the phrase Alexa, laugh'; Engadget: same statement

facts.claim: Amazon disabled the short command, changed the phrase to 'Alexa, can you laugh?' as less likely to cause false positives, and changed the reply to 'Sure, I can laugh' before laughing
facts.note: NPR: changing the phrase to 'Alexa, can you laugh?', disabling the short command, response 'Sure, I can laugh' followed by laughter; Engadget: less likely to produce false positives

facts.claim: Amazon's initial statement had not said what went wrong
facts.note: Engadget: initial statement did not say what went wrong

instagram.caption: The smart speaker that laughed on its own: a misheard phrase, a disabled command, and a longer phrase as the fix.
